## Definition of Done
This issue is considered resolved when:
- The maintainer has independently verified the submitted information
- The registry entry (if approved) has been added by the maintainer directly
- This issue is closed with a link to the commit or PR that added it

Note: submitting this issue does not itself add the anchor to the registry. Registry changes are made by the maintainer after verification, not merged directly from a contributor PR.
